I guess the problem comes from Voat not being extremely popular. This and other two subs I'm in here are very active on Reddit. Also, it helps if other users also post one thing or another. The problem with game-specific subs like PSO2's is that people resort to it mostly to solve technical issues. If it's an offline game, like FFXII, the sub is deserted for the most part cos people very rarely have anything to say at all, or anything to share.

Yes, unfortunately setting up the game on any server other than a Western one is a hassle for most people. Even if you tell them there's no lag and the patches make the game perfectly playable, they always stay skeptical. There are new players popping up everyday, but most of them use Reddit, start using Reddit because of the game or don't use that at all. Voat is still pretty much in the shadows despite the issues Reddit had recently, so unfortunately there's nothing you or any of us can do to make this sub more popular. I think the most we can try, as I said before, is encourage people to post more, or organize events.
